---
name: ace-music
description: Use ACE Music tools to create songs from a prompt or custom lyrics, upload reference audio, cover or blend owned tracks, and retrieve original task results.
---

# ACE Music

Use `acemusic_list_models` and `acemusic_get_capabilities` for discovery. A song request creates two candidate tracks. Use `acemusic_generate_music` for an idea or `acemusic_generate_custom_music` when the user provides a title, lyrics and style. The default is `acemusic-v1.1` and `acemusic-v1` also supports ordinary generation. Create separate lyrics with `acemusic_generate_lyrics` when requested.

For reference work, `acemusic_upload_audio` imports one publicly accessible HTTPS MP3 as a separately priced operation. Use `acemusic_cover_audio` for one owned platform audio ID, or `acemusic_mashup_audio` for two distinct compatible owned audio IDs. These operations use `acemusic-v1.1` with lyrics and style. An audio ID identifies a track in the completed task; a task ID identifies the request. Confirm the user's intended action and consult [current pricing](https://platform.acedata.cloud/services/acemusic) before spending.

Save the original task ID and call `acemusic_get_task` until that task finishes. Batch lookup and history are available through `acemusic_get_tasks_batch` and `acemusic_list_tasks`. Authenticated task queries are free. For `succeeded`, return completed tracks and their URLs. For `partial_failed`, identify surviving tracks and report the partial result. For `failed`, report the error. For `submission_unknown`, keep the same task ID for reconciliation. Avoid paying for a duplicate request after a timeout.

# ACE Music for OpenCode 2

[简体中文](readme/README_zh_Hans.md)

Create ACE Music songs and lyrics, upload reference audio, cover one owned track, blend two, and retrieve the original task. This OpenCode 2 integration connects to the [hosted ACE Music MCP](https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/mcp-acemusic). You can use the plugin independently of other music integrations.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add github:AceDataCloud/ACEMusicOpenCode
```

Requires OpenCode 2.0.26 or newer in the 2.x series. In OpenCode use `/connect` and select ACE Music by Ace Data Cloud, or expose `ACEDATACLOUD_ACEMUSIC_API_TOKEN` to OpenCode using your secret manager. Reconnect after changing the key. Get a general or service API key with ACE Music access from [Applications](https://platform.acedata.cloud/console/applications). Enter the raw key through the client configuration. Keep it out of prompts and repositories.

## First use

Ask “List the ACE Music models and capabilities.” This only reads service information. To make a song, describe the idea or provide the title, lyrics and style. A successful song task returns two candidates. Uploading a reference and generating lyrics are separate billable actions. For a cover, supply one owned audio ID; for a mashup, two different compatible IDs. Keep the returned task ID and query it after reconnecting. [Pricing](https://platform.acedata.cloud/services/acemusic) · [MCP tool reference](https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/mcp-acemusic)

## Verify the packed plugin

Run `npm test` for credential registration, rotation and revocation. To exercise the packaged plugin against the OpenCode 2.0.26 runtime with an empty credential store:

```sh
npm install --prefix /tmp/ace-music-opencode-host --no-save @opencode/cli@2.0.26
OPENCODE_BIN=/tmp/ace-music-opencode-host/node_modules/.bin/opencode npm run test:e2e
```

The test packs this repository, starts an isolated loopback host, and checks that it registered the ACE Music skill and key/environment credential methods. The remote MCP stays disabled until the user provides a credential.

# 在 OpenCode 2 中使用 ACE Music

[English](../README.md)

此插件连接 [ACE Music MCP](https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/mcp-acemusic)。可按描述或自定义歌词创作歌曲、上传参考音频、翻唱一条自己的音轨、融合两条不同的兼容音轨，并查询原任务。

## 安装

```sh
opencode plugin add github:AceDataCloud/ACEMusicOpenCode
```

需要 OpenCode 2.0.26 或更新的 2.x。通过 `/connect` 选择 ACE Music by Ace Data Cloud 并绑定服务 Key，也可通过密钥管理器向 OpenCode 提供 `ACEDATACLOUD_ACEMUSIC_API_TOKEN`。更改密钥后重新连接。 在[应用管理](https://platform.acedata.cloud/console/applications)创建允许访问 ACE Music 的通用或服务 API Key。将原始 Key 提供给客户端的凭据配置，避免粘贴到对话或代码中。

先问“ACE Music 支持哪些模型和操作？”即可免费查看。输入主题或提供标题、歌词和风格可以创作歌曲，成功后交付两首候选。生成歌词与导入参考音频分别计费。保留返回的任务 ID，断线后查询同一任务；部分失败时可取回已完成的音轨。[服务价格](https://platform.acedata.cloud/services/acemusic) · [工具说明](https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/mcp-acemusic)
